latest.title: Kyntex Band 1.6.2
latest.notes: Requires Kyntex iOS 2.4.2 or later. The band now records only after it has confirmed the selected athlete's profile, and keeps that athlete's calibration when a workout starts, fixing Knee Load reading zero. Workouts start after about 1.5 seconds of steady high band pressure and end after 3 seconds of low pressure. Landings and hard events count at any band pressure. End your workout and charge the band to at least 40% before installing.
